svg.title: The recommended 0402 footprint
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. The recommended 0402 (1005 metric) footprint: two pads 0.6 mm long and 0.7 mm wide on a 1.0 mm pitch, leaving a 0.4 mm gap. The 1.0 × 0.5 mm part sits with both metal ends on the pads.

g.text: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
